BENEXT(8) FreeBSD System Manager's Manual BENEXT(8)

NAME

benext — one-shot boot environment trials with fallback to a protected boot environment

SYNOPSIS

benext protect be

benext try be

benext abort

benext boot-arm

benext confirm

benext status [--json]

benext destroy be

benext rename old new

benext mount-rw be dir

benext prune [keep]

benext --check-config [file]

DESCRIPTION

benext boots a new boot environment once and falls back automatically. The fallback order is: the one-shot trial, then the last good boot environment, then the protected boot environment.

protect be
Mark be as the protected boot environment (org.cloudbsd:protected=on). Only one may be protected. It cannot be destroyed, renamed, mounted read-write, tried, or pruned through benext.
try be
Record the current bootfs as the last good boot environment, arm panic power-cycle in the running system and in be, and activate be for one boot with bectl activate -t. Aborts if bootfs changed.
abort
Cancel a pending trial.
boot-arm
Run early in boot by rc.d/benext_arm. Activates the protected boot environment for one boot, so a hard failure of the current boot lands on it.
confirm
Run late in boot by rc.d/benext_confirm. Runs the executable health checks in checks_dir. On success, disarms and makes a trial permanent. On failure, reboots to the fallback.
status [--json]
Print the state in human-readable form or JSON.
prune [keep]
Destroy old boot environments, keeping the original, active, next-boot, last good, trial, and protected ones plus the newest keep.
--check-config [file]
Validate the configuration; exit 0 if valid, 4 with a message if not.

FILES

/etc/benext/config.json
Configuration, see benext.json(5).
/etc/benext.d/
Default health-check directory.
/etc/rc.d/benext_arm, /etc/rc.d/benext_confirm
Boot hooks, enabled with benext_enable="YES" in rc.conf(5).

EXIT STATUS

0 on success, 2 for a bad argument or state, 3 when the protected boot environment is refused, 4 for a configuration error, 5 when bootfs changed during try, 64 for a usage error.

SEE ALSO

benext.json(5), loader.conf(5), bectl(8), zfsbootcfg(8)

BUGS

A hard failure of the last good boot environment before rc.d/benext_arm runs cannot reach the protected boot environment without loader support.
